description: Human gene lookup — Look up a human gene by official symbol= (e.g. BRCA1; former names and aliases like FANCS resolve to the current symbol) or search with q= free text (e.g. insulin receptor, limit=1-25). Returns NCBI Gene ID, official name, gene type, chromosome and cytogenetic location, aliases, other names, HGNC, OMIM and Ensembl IDs, and links. Source: NCBI Gene via the NLM Clinical Table Search Service (US government, public domain). Reference data, not medical advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_gene
